mechanism: Metoclopramide is a dopamine antagonist that may counteract the stimulant effects of lisdexamfetamine, while both drugs increase CNS stimulation risk and metoclopramide may lower seizure threshold in amphetamine users.
action: Monitor for reduced efficacy of lisdexamfetamine and increased risk of dystonia or akathisia; consider alternative antiemetic if possible or use lowest effective metoclopramide dose.
